ai_summary: The funding supports later-stage research and development for previously funded NIH SBIR or STTR projects. Only United States small business concerns that have received an NIH SBIR or STTR Phase II award can apply, with a limit of one award per project.
ai_quote: The Phase IIB Strategic Breakthrough provides previously funded NIH SBIR or STTR projects additional support for later-stage research and development (R&D).
